title: Purair® DWS™ Ductless Downflow Workstations
meta_title: Purair DWS Ductless Downflow Workstations - Protect Users from Hazardous Vapors
meta_description: Purair DWS Downflow Workstations are ductless fume hoods designed to protect users and the environment from hazardous vapors. Unrestricted access for complex applications.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, downflow workstation, hazardous vapor protection, laboratory safety equipment
short_description: Purair® DWS™ Downflow Workstations are ductless fume hoods designed to protect the user and the environment from hazardous vapors generated on the work surface. Unrestricted front and side access permits applications requiring complex user involvement. Downward airflow in the chamber protects the operator.
full_description: Available in 3 standard sizes, in metal or polypropylene construction, totaling 6 models. Wider units, comprising two or more workstations can be positioned side-by-side with junction connections option. Downward airflow protects operator from fume and particle hazards. Unrestricted front and side access to work area. Filter blockage alarm. The Air Science high capacity filters are easy to access, easy to change. A unique filter clamping design eliminates bypass leakage outside the cabinet. Redesigned DWS offers increased internal height.
seo_content: Using innovative filtration technology, the DWS Downflow Workstations create a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry, including Chemical, Dental, Forensic, Histology, Industrial, Microscopy, Pharmaceutical, Powder Fingerprinting, and Veterinary applications.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
